method: Public Artifact Tool rendered the final exported/reimported workbook at each planned range. All seventy-six resulting PNGs were displayed and visually inspected individually; the six baseline PNGs were reviewed separately before authoring.
observations: All planned modified zones and representative appended families were reviewed: synthesis, feature totals, ten fighters, move groups, two arenas, promoted and original atlas rows, production categories, scenarios, current QA and references.
The established purple/white table style, green implemented statuses, amber open review or partial statuses, yellow user-note columns, native numeric formats and wrapped review text were preserved.

Current counts, formulas and sources agree with the native comparison and companion data; no visual overflow, lost review columns, unreadable hash truncation or formula error was found in the rendered scopes.

Official identity, unconfirmed archival attribution and original Encore designs remain visibly distinct. Procedural/static art, unexecuted browser coverage and open canonical comparison are not marked as complete canonical animation.

limitations: These are scoped spreadsheet renders, not a desktop Excel application session.
The review concerns workbook presentation and truthful status reporting. It does not certify canonical 1:1 art or physical-device gameplay.
Wide multi-column source and review tables retain the existing workbook architecture rather than being redesigned.
